title: Password reset help
excerpt: Use the reset link, verify your email, and create a new password with at least 12 characters.

title: Two-factor authentication setup
excerpt: Enable 2FA from the security settings page and use an authenticator app for login verification.

title: Billing invoice questions
excerpt: Invoices are emailed after purchase. If you need a duplicate, share the order ID or invoice number.

title: Refund policy
excerpt: Refunds are processed within 5-10 business days after approval for eligible purchases.

title: Account recovery steps
excerpt: Use the account recovery flow to reset your password and verify your recovery email.

title: App crashes on startup
excerpt: Clear the app cache and reinstall the latest version if the app crashes during startup.

title: Subscription cancellation
excerpt: Cancel from your account settings before the next billing cycle if you want to stop recurring charges.

title: Payment failure troubleshooting
excerpt: Payment failures can happen if the card is expired or the bank blocks the transaction; try another payment method.

title: Account takeover protection
excerpt: If you notice unauthorized access, reset your password immediately and contact support for a security review.

title: Plan upgrade help
excerpt: Upgrading your plan is available from the billing section under account settings.

title: Download missing from dashboard
excerpt: If files are not showing up in the dashboard, refresh the page and ensure your download permissions are enabled.

title: Order confirmation details
excerpt: Order confirmations are sent by email and also shown in your purchase history.

title: Locked account recovery
excerpt: Locked accounts can be restored after identity verification and a password reset.

title: Device sync issue
excerpt: Try reconnecting the device or re-authenticating to restore syncing with your workspace.

title: Payment method update
excerpt: Update or replace your payment method under billing settings before the next invoice is issued.
